T: Father and son. Same radio. Same pizza.
D: A cop talks to his firefighter father across 30 years through an old ham radio.
P: Serve dinner during the 1969 World Series broadcast.
S: Beef chilli spooned into baked wonton cups, cheddar on top, back in the oven for 3 minutes.
Miracle Mets pretzels with beer mustard
the 1969 World Series, the Miracle Mets on the radio

Warm ballpark soft pretzels glossy from a bicarb bath, coarse salt on top, with a sharp beer and wholegrain mustard dip. Mix 500g plain flour, 7g dried yeast, 1 tsp sugar, 1 tsp salt and 300ml warm water, knead 8 minutes and rise 1 hour. Shape 8 pretzels. Boil each for 30 seconds in 2 litres water with 60g bicarb, drain, sprinkle with coarse salt and bake at 220C for 12 to 14 minutes. Mix 100g wholegrain mustard, 2 tbsp lager and 1 tbsp honey for the dip.
M: the shift dinner for the whole crew
Beef and pork ragù simmered 2 hours, layered with pasta sheets, ricotta and béchamel, mozzarella on top, baked at 180C for 45 minutes, rested 20.
watching the Series on the radio
Cold-fermented dough stretched thin, crushed tomato, low-moisture mozzarella and crumbled Italian sausage, baked on a hot steel at max heat for 7 minutes.
W: Granny Smiths with sugar, cinnamon and a little flour in a double crust, egg wash, baked at 190C for 50 minutes.
K: the 1969 World Series on the radio at the firehouse

Cold lager topped with fresh homemade lemonade and mint in frosted glasses, easy drinking for nine innings. Stir 100ml lemon juice, 80g caster sugar and 300ml cold water until the sugar dissolves. Chill 4 glasses in the freezer for 20 minutes. Pour 200ml cold lager into each glass and top with 100ml lemonade. Add a sprig of mint and a lemon wheel.

edition.tagline: Father and son. Same radio. Same pizza.
edition.cue: Serve dinner during the 1969 World Series broadcast.

s.note: Beef and bean chilli in baked wonton cups with melted cheddar.
s.how: Press 12 wonton wrappers into a lightly oiled mini muffin tin. Bake at 180°C conventional for 7 minutes until crisp. Brown 200g beef mince in 1 tsp oil for 5 minutes, add 1/2 diced onion and cook 3 minutes. Stir in 1 tsp chilli powder, 200g chopped tinned tomatoes and 120g drained kidney beans. Simmer 15 minutes until thick. Spoon into the baked cups, top with 60g grated cheddar and return to the oven for 3 minutes to melt. Serve three cups each.

s.n: Miracle Mets pretzels with beer mustard
s.note: Warm ballpark soft pretzels glossy from a bicarb bath, coarse salt on top, with a sharp beer and wholegrain mustard dip.
s.how: Mix 500g plain flour, 7g dried yeast, 1 tsp sugar, 1 tsp salt and 300ml warm water, knead 8 minutes and rise 1 hour. Shape 8 pretzels. Boil each for 30 seconds in 2 litres water with 60g bicarb, drain, sprinkle with coarse salt and bake at 220C for 12 to 14 minutes. Mix 100g wholegrain mustard, 2 tbsp lager and 1 tbsp honey for the dip.

m.note: Thin crisp pizza with crushed tomato, mozzarella and crumbled Italian sausage.
m.how: Mix 380g bread flour, 2g dried yeast, 1 tsp salt and 245ml cool water; knead 8 minutes. Divide into two balls and refrigerate covered for 24 to 48 hours to cold-ferment. Bring to room temperature for 2 hours. Heat a pizza steel at the oven's maximum temperature, about 250 to 275°C, for 45 minutes. Remove 200g Italian sausages from their casings and crumble; pan-fry 5 minutes until cooked. Stretch the dough thin into two pizzas. Top with 200g crushed tomatoes, 200g low-moisture mozzarella and the sausage, dividing evenly. Bake each on the steel for about 7 minutes until crisp and cooked. Cut into wedges for four people.

w.note: Double crust apple pie with cinnamon, sugar and golden egg wash.
w.how: Line a 20cm pie dish with half of 400g sweet shortcrust pastry. Peel, core and thinly slice 600g Granny Smith apples. Toss with 80g caster sugar, 1 tsp cinnamon and 15g plain flour. Fill the pastry, cover with the remaining pastry and crimp the edges. Cut two steam vents, brush with 1 beaten egg and sprinkle with 1 tsp extra sugar. Bake at 190°C conventional for 50 minutes until golden and the apples are tender. Rest 20 minutes and cut into four portions.

d.note: Cold lager topped with fresh homemade lemonade and mint in frosted glasses, easy drinking for nine innings.
d.how: Stir 100ml lemon juice, 80g caster sugar and 300ml cold water until the sugar dissolves. Chill 4 glasses in the freezer for 20 minutes. Pour 200ml cold lager into each glass and top with 100ml lemonade. Add a sprig of mint and a lemon wheel.
